question: What is the vibration test duration for the RADAR-100?
answer:
The vibration test duration for the RADAR-100 is 2 hours per axis, as specified in [EQSPEC-RADAR-100_RevB.pdf, p.3.2.2] (MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8, Category 4). 

Note: The earlier version [EQSPEC-RADAR-100_RevA.pdf, p.3.2.2] specified 1 hour per axis, but it was superseded by [EQSPEC-RADAR-100_RevB.pdf].

question: What is the measurement principle of the TUF-2000 flow meter?
answer: The TUF-2000 flow meter utilizes the transit-time principle to measure the velocity of relatively clean liquids in full pipes. [TUF-2000-Series-User-Manual.pdf, p.3].
